summary: Four churches (Blessed Sacrament Mohawk, St. Francis de Sales Herkimer, St. John the Baptist Newport, Sts. Anthony & Joseph Herkimer). The newest (Nov 1, 3-page) bulletin prints no Mass schedule: only Saturday 3:00 Reconciliation and a Thursday Noon Mass reference at Sts. Anthony & Joseph. Weekend Masses are settled from the Oct 11 intentions plus the parish's current Mass Times page (R6), as are the Tuesday and Friday weekday Masses. Open: Thursday 12:00 vs 12:05, a Friday Holy Hour at Newport, and the Wednesday Mass pattern.
